correctness.rationale: Uniqueness follows from strict convexity of trace inverse on the connected Laplacian cone, plus graph automorphism averaging. Four exact Laplacian eigenvalue multiplicities yield the two-variable Kemeny formula. Clique capacity saturation reduces to a strictly convex scalar F, whose endpoint derivative is provably negative for both q>=p and p>q>=2. This verifies every boundary and the exact cross-only gap; verify_split.py passes 168156 additional exact checks from actual content.

value.rationale: Uniform-stationary Kemeny minimization under local stochasticity constraints is a motivated natural design problem with global spectral coupling. The theorem completely characterizes an infinite two-parameter graph family, including all edge weights, every equality case, exact support phase at p=q, and a sharp deletion penalty whose relative magnitude diverges for fixed q and p increasing. The result is not a routine parameter substitution of the SLEM formula or the global-budget resistance optimum; it quantifies a meaningful graph-structure choice.
